ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with localized high-intensity (white) regions at the lateral tips; approximate 85:15 dark-to-light distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white patches at the lateral extremities. The left tip contains a solid white area transitioning to mottling. The right tip exhibits complex, vertical/diagonal dendritic white banding and high-intensity clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center; angle estimated at 55 degrees with significant depth penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire horizontal boundary; includes several deep, non-uniform indentations (peaks and valleys) varying from 2 to 10 pixels in depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the central notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple isolated high-intensity circular points scattered across the dark central region; dense cluster of circular nodes (barnacle morphology) on the superior-lateral edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel, vertically-oriented linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on both the left and right distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged irregular excision/missing tissue on the superior margin of the right lobe; extensive rake-mark scarring visible on the high-contrast lateral fields.
other_distinctive_markers: Small, distinct cluster of 3-4 white circular points (potential barnacles) localized in the lower-central dark field of the left lobe.
